title: MERS-CoV-nsp5 expression in human epithelial BEAS 2b cells attenuates type I interferon production by inhibiting IRF3 nuclear translocation.
authors: Zhang, Y; Kandwal, S; Fayne, D; Stevenson, N J
journal: Cellular and molecular life sciences : CMLS
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MERS-CoV-nsp5通过结合IRF3抑制其核转位从而减弱I型干扰素产生，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作及MD模拟，但对象为病毒蛋白与宿主转录因子IRF3的互作，非TF-DNA结合体系，方法可迁移但非核心匹配。
abstract: Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus (MERS-CoV) is an enveloped, positive-sense RNA virus that emerged in 2012, causing sporadic cases and localized outbreaks of severe respiratory illness with high fatality rates. A characteristic feature of the immune response to MERS-CoV infection is low type I IFN induction, despite its importance in viral clearance. The non-structural proteins (nsps) of other coronaviruses have been shown to block IFN production. However, the role of nsp5 from MERS-CoV in IFN induction of human respiratory cells is unclear. In this study, we elucidated the role of MERS-CoV-nsp5, the viral main protease, in modulating the host's antiviral responses in human bronchial epithelial BEAS 2b cells. We found that overexpression of MERS-CoV-nsp5 had a dose-dependent inhibitory effect on IFN-beta promoter activation and cytokine production induced by HMW-poly(I:C). It also suppressed IFN-beta promoter activation triggered by overexpression of key components in the RIG-I-like receptor (RLR) pathway, including RIG-I, MAVS, IKK-epsilon and IRF3. Moreover, the overexpression of MERS-CoV-nsp5 did not impair expression or phosphorylation of IRF3, but suppressed the nuclear translocation of IRF3. Further investigation revealed that MERS-CoV-nsp5 specifically interacted with IRF3. Using docking and molecular dynamic (MD) simulations, we also found that amino acids on MERS-CoV-nsp5, IRF3, and KPNA4 may participate in protein-protein interactions. Additionally, we uncovered protein conformations that mask the nuclear localization signal (NLS) regions of IRF3 and KPNA4 when interacting with MERS-CoV-nsp5, suggesting a mechanism by which this viral protein blocks IRF3 nuclear translocation. Of note, the IFN-beta expression was restored after administration of protease inhibitors targeting nsp5, indicating this suppression of IFN-beta production was dependent on the enzyme activity of nsp5. Collectively, our findings elucidate a mechanism by which MERS-CoV-nsp5 disrupts the host's innate antiviral immunity and thus provides insights into viral pathogenesis.
abstract_zh: 中东呼吸综合征冠状病毒（MERS-CoV）是一种有包膜的正链RNA病毒，于2012年出现，引起散发病例和局部暴发的严重呼吸道疾病，病死率较高。MERS-CoV感染免疫反应的一个特征是I型干扰素诱导水平较低，尽管其在病毒清除中具有重要作用。其他冠状病毒的非结构蛋白（nsps）已被证明能阻断干扰素的产生。然而，MERS-CoV的nsp5在人呼吸道细胞干扰素诱导中的作用尚不清楚。在本研究中，我们阐明了MERS-CoV-nsp5（病毒主要蛋白酶）在人气道上皮BEAS 2b细胞中调节宿主抗病毒反应的作用。我们发现，MERS-CoV-nsp5的过表达对HMW-poly(I:C)诱导的IFN-β启动子激活和细胞因子产生具有剂量依赖性抑制作用。它还抑制了RIG-I样受体（RLR）通路关键组分（包括RIG-I、MAVS、IKK-ε和IRF3）过表达触发的IFN-β启动子激活。此外，MERS-CoV-nsp5的过表达并未损害IRF3的表达或磷酸化，但抑制了IRF3的核转位。进一步研究表明，MERS-CoV-nsp5与IRF3特异性相互作用。通过对接和分子动力学（MD）模拟，我们还发现MERS-CoV-nsp5、IRF3和KPNA4上的氨基酸可能参与蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。此外，我们揭示了在与MERS-CoV-nsp5相互作用时，蛋白质构象会掩蔽IRF3和KPNA4的核定位信号（NLS）区域，提示该病毒蛋白阻断IRF3核转位的一种机制。值得注意的是，在给予靶向nsp5的蛋白酶抑制剂后，IFN-β表达得以恢复，表明这种对IFN-β产生的抑制依赖于nsp5的酶活性。总体而言，我们的发现阐明了MERS-CoV-nsp5破坏宿主固有抗病毒免疫的机制，从而为病毒发病机制提供了见解。
